summary.text: Eric Bassler is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 39, serving since 2014.
The caucus page lists Bassler as chair of the Ethics Committee and of the School Funding Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Bassler holds a B.A. in chemistry and psychology and an M.A. in economics from Indiana University.
The page lists his occupation as financial advisor at Edward Jones in Washington, Indiana, since 2000, and earlier work as a U.S. Peace Corps business development consultant in Albania and Ukraine.
Bassler served as an at-large member of the City of Washington Common Council, and he represents Daviess, Greene, Knox and Martin counties and portions of Owen and Sullivan counties.
